title: Projection smoothness cannot promote epistemic authority
rule: The endpoint claim ceiling equals the most restrictive grounding status on the selected projection path.
order: GROUNDED if all edges are supported
MODEL_ONLY if any edge is assumed and none are unknown/falsified
UNKNOWN if any edge is unknown and none are falsified
FALSIFIED if any required edge is falsified
invariant: Explanation smoothness must not launder an assumption into evidence.
boundary: This is an epistemic bookkeeping rule for DCS artifacts, not a statistical confidence model.
